# patches #516: Patch for bug #4054 that changes geniCodeSEParms for struct arguments of the form *p

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/patches/516/
- Category: [Duplicates](../../duplicate.md)
- Evidence: judged by reading, against r17193
- Recommended action: Close together with bug #4054 when the patch of that entry is applied. This patch was read and was not built.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The ticket has a patch for bug #4054. For an argument of struct type for which `IS_DEREF_OP` is
true, the patch makes `geniCodeSEParms` in `src/SDCCicode.c` evaluate the left operand of the
argument and use that value as the address of the argument. It also adds
`support/regression/tests/bug-4054.c`. The patch was read against r17193. It was not built, and
its effect was not tested.

## Reason

Bug #4054 reports the defect, and its entry has a patch that removes the cause in
`geniCodeDerefPtr`. The two patches differ in these points:

- The patch of this ticket keeps the read through the pointer in `geniCodeDerefPtr`. The argument
  `(e, *p)`, the value of the assignment in `x = *p = y`, and the operands of conditional
  expressions (#4163, #3857) are not evaluated by the line that it changes. On r17193 the argument
  `(e, *p)` fails for stm8 and ucz80 in `bug-4054-2.c`, the test of the other patch.
- `IS_DEREF_OP` in `src/SDCCast.h` is true for `.` and `->` as well as for `*`. For an argument
  `w.m` or `p->m` of struct type, the patch evaluates `w` or `p`, and `geniCodeStruct`, which adds
  the offset of the member, is not called. Trunk passes these two arguments correctly for mcs51.
  They were not compiled with the patch.
- The patch of this ticket keeps the replacement of `p[i]` by `p + i` in `geniCodeSEParms`. With
  that replacement, the compiler rejects `f (p[i])` for mcs51 with error 129 when `p` is a generic
  pointer.
- Trunk has `bug-4054.c` since [r16831](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/16831/) with its body
  disabled. The patch for bug #4054 enables the body.
